# Azure Compliance — azqr Security Audits

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's compliance and security auditing skill: run comprehensive azqr scans over a subscription or resource group to assess Azure best-practice adherence, plus dedicated Key Vault expiration monitoring for keys, secrets and certificates, then classify findings (critical/high/medium/low) with remediation guidance for each. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: scans are read-only but can take a while on large subscriptions — schedule them weekly or monthly; the skill reports and prioritizes findings, it doesn't remediate anything itself. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
